shortDescription: According to Bloomberg, IQVIA Holdings Inc. is nearing a roughly $1.1 billion takeover of Quotient Sciences, a UK drug services group. The US clinical research company is looking to expand its role in bringing new medicines to market.

title: IQVIA Nears $1.1 Billion Deal for UK Drug Services Group Quotient
